include(GrPlatform) #define LIB_SUFFIX

list(APPEND bchcoder_sources
    bchencoder_bb_impl.cc
    bchclass.cc
    bchdecoder_bb_impl.cc)

set(bchcoder_sources
    "${bchcoder_sources}"
    PARENT_SCOPE)
if(NOT bchcoder_sources)
    message(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT bchcoder_sources)

add_library(gnuradio-bchcoder SHARED ${bchcoder_sources})
target_link_libraries(gnuradio-bchcoder gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime)
target_include_directories(
    gnuradio-bchcoder
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
set_target_properties(gnuradio-bchcoder PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_bchcoder_EXPORTS")

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-bchcoder PROPERTIES INSTALL_NAME_DIR
                                                    "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib")
endif(APPLE)

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
gr_library_foo(gnuradio-bchcoder)

########################################################################
# Print summary
########################################################################

message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")
